title: Restore advice speed headroom on the 6-max actions spot and the 9-seat calling-range spot
description: Follow-up from TASK-7.34 (doc-167). 'actions: 6-max flop facing a bet, one opponent' sits at ~79% of its 25 ms target (~15 ms outside equity, likely estimateOpponentRanges). The 9-seat vs 8 opponents spot needed a 200 ms target (TASK-7.34 Q-1) and runs ~132 ms against a 150 ms headroom limit; reaching 100 ms needs a faster multiway calling-range sampler, which may change seeded results.

nodes.title: Restore advice speed headroom on the 6-max actions spot and the 9-seat calling-range spot
Bootstrap the strict TypeScript project with one-command checks
Rank showdown hands by real poker hand rankings
Run every check in GitHub Actions on each push and pull request
Compute a hand's equity against opponent hands
Make the advice speed checks opt-in and restore headroom on the remaining tight spots

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given the opt-in advice perf test, When 'actions: 6-max flop facing a bet, one opponent' runs at real targets, Then its p95 is at most 75% of 25 ms with advice results unchanged (playtest SHA identical)

Given a faster multiway calling-range sampler, When the 9-seat vs 8 opponents spot runs, Then its p95 is at most 75 ms (75% of 100 ms), and any change to seeded advice or bot results is measured and approved by the user before merge
